notes.title: Critter Crunch 15th Anniversary Stream!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We want to express our thanks for all your love for Critter Crunch. It’s heartwarming and encouraging for our team, knowing our beloved game has a special place in your life. 💙

We want to invite you to our stream tomorrow at 4PM ET! [b]We'll be showcasing the Capy Classic™ Critter Crunch, in honour of its 15th iOS anniversary and as Bianca's OFFICIAL First Playthrough![/b] 🖥️💙✨ Christian will be guiding Bianca on this exciting adventure! We’re also excited to present some fun facts about the game through its development and release with a special guest!

[b]Not only will it be streamed on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/capygames]Twitch[/url], but on our store page as well![/b] We hope you can join us wherever it’s convenient! 

And to celebrate this stream, we’re happy to have another sale for [b]Critter Crunch, at 80% off until August 6th!![/b] Feel free to follow along with your own first, second, third, or maybe even tenth playthrough of the game! 💙🐛✨

notes.title: Happy 15 years of Critter Crunch!
notes.notes:
Happy 15 years of Critter Crunch! 🐛💙✨ We can’t believe it’s been that long since it came out on iOS… Thank you to everyone who has supported our game and our precious long-tongue boy!

While the Steam version is not the iOS version, we still wanted to give love to our community! It is still on sale for 86% off as part of the Steam Summer Sale until July 13th 🌞 Buy it again, buy it for a friend, your family, maybe even a stranger? 

And to those that have it and played it, and even continue to play it to this day, please know we appreciate you immensely! 💙

Have a sketchy, bouncy Biggs!

notes.title: Now Available - Critter Crunch
notes.notes:
Critter Crunch is now available on Steam and is 10% off until September 18th at 10AM Pacific Time!

Critter Crunch is an award winning, arcade-style puzzle game, starring the loveable Biggs. Using his long, sticky tongue to grab critters from vines above, he feeds them to each other until they burst, dropping tasty jewels for him to gobble up.
